chunks: And by this chain, he said: Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
If there is anything with evil omen in it, so it is in the tongue.
ai.seo_question: What part of the body is considered to carry an evil omen according to the Prophet?
ai.summary: In *Al-Kafi*, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this hadith to emphasize the tongue's pivotal role in human conduct, framing silence not merely as absence of speech but as a protective shield against the 'evil omen' (*shu'm*) of verbal missteps. This aligns with Shia ethical teachings that view the tongue as the most volatile instrument, capable of bringing ruin through gossip (*ghibah*) or cursing, thus making its preservation a key component of *zuhd* (asceticism) and spiritual refinement.
